messages.author: 20ef7352079c6950
messages.subject: loading sam file takes lot of time
parts:
Hi
I am trying to load the .sam files from bismark alignment into methylkit R interface.. the file size is around 20gb.
But calling methylation for each sample takes around 5 to 6 hrs.
Is there any way that it can be made to run faster using multi cores.. ?

# my sample code
library(methylKit)
library(graphics)

# this is a list of example files, ships with the package
file.list=list( "44116.R1.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sorted.sam",    
                "44117.R1.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sorted.sam",    
                "44121.R1.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sorted.sam",
                "44133.R1.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sorted.sam",
                "44135.R1.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sorted.sam",
                "44137.R1.fastq_bismark_bt2_pe.deduplicated.sorted.sam")


# read the files to a methylRawList object: myobj
myobj=read.bismark(file.list, sample.id=list("44116","44117","44121","44133", "44135", "44137"), assembly="hg19",
         save.folder=getwd(), save.context = c("CpG") , read.context="CpG",
                  nolap=FALSE,mincov=10,minqual=20,phred64=FALSE,treatment=c(0,0,0, 1,1,1))



thank you
